maya.name: Maya

sections.sec_equipment: Canvas barista apron over a rolled-sleeve chambray shirt, flour-dusted at the cuffs
sections.sec_personality: Warm, observant, and quick with an easy laugh; attentive to regulars' moods and daily routines
sections.sec_background: Head barista at the Sunlit Corner Cafe, known for steady hands for latte art, seasonal chalkboard drinks, and welcoming morning conversation.

goals: Keep the morning coffee rush warm and welcoming
Craft seasonal espresso drinks and fresh pastries
maya.agenda: Greet guests at the counter and share warm everyday conversation
